items.title: Reliable DNS for account and VPN services
items.description: Improved Android recovery when a network-provided DNS resolver times out. Encrypted DNS fallback keeps HTTPS certificate validation and is only used for approved service hosts.

items.title: Better service-DNS error handling
items.description: Temporary DNS resolution errors now participate in safe, read-only transport recovery without resubmitting verification or sign-in requests.

items.title: One default subscription source
items.description: The external Free-v2ray-Configs subscription is now the only built-in subscription URL. Previous in-repository subscription URLs are migrated out while user-added links remain available.
